name: Project Andromeda
source:
In Project Andromeda, you play as the captain of a spaceship destined to explore the Andromeda Galaxy.

You will be responsible for getting your crew to its destination, your choices will impact the success of settlements and colonies.

Get ready for some lewd action as you rampage through a whole new galaxy with plenty of unknown species and infinite possibilities.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/andromedalab]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在《仙女座计划》中，你扮演一艘注定要探索仙女座星系的宇宙飞船的船长。

你将负责让你的船员到达目的地，你的选择将影响定居点和殖民地的成功。

当你在一个充满未知物种和无限可能性的全新星系中横冲直撞时，准备好进行一些淫荡的行动吧。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/andromedalab]Patreon[/url]]
